name: Quanzhou Jiadeli Electronics Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Quanzhou Jiadeli Electronics Material Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of polypropylene films for capacitors in China. Its products are used in photovoltaic industry, household appliances, energy storage business, power, industrial automation control, wind energy industry, rail, new energy vehicles, and other high-end manufacturing fields. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Quanzhou, China.
